plant_name: NTPC Barh Super Thermal Power Station (एनटीपीसी बाढ़ सुपर थर्मल पावर स्टेशन)

location.exact_site: Barh, Patna district, Ganga river side

technical_metrics.coal_linkage_or_source: Stage-I: CCL mines; Stage-II: Chatti-Bariatu Mines, NTPC

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Ganga water + railway connectivity + coal transport
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Barh Super Thermal Power Station Patna district ke Barh area mein Ganga ke paas sthit hai. Bade coal-based plant ke liye do cheezein bahut important hoti hain—lagataar paani aur coal ki reliable supply. Barh ko Ganga se cooling water milta hai, jabki coal railway network ke through linked mines se aata hai. NTPC ke official profile mein approved capacity 3300 MW di gayi hai. Plant ka configuration Stage-I mein 3x660 MW aur Stage-II mein 2x660 MW hai. 2025 mein Stage-I ke Unit-3, 660 MW, ka COD declare hone ke baad Barh ki full 3300 MW configuration operational ho gayi. Isliye purane notes mein 2640 MW dekhkar confuse nahi hona chahiye. BPSC ke map question mein Barh ko Patna + Ganga + NTPC + 3300 MW ke combination se yaad rakhein.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: Bihar ko Barh-I se 683.36 MW aur Barh-II se 1024.98 MW firm allocation listed hai; total 1708.34 MW
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Barh ki total commissioned capacity 3300 MW hai, lekin poori electricity sirf Bihar ko nahi milti. Eastern Region ke power-allocation data mein Bihar ka Barh-I share 683.36 MW aur Barh-II share 1024.98 MW listed hai. Yani Bihar ka combined firm allocation 1708.34 MW ke aas-paas hai. Baaki power beneficiary states ko allocated hoti hai. Ye distinction exam mein important hai—'plant capacity' aur 'Bihar allocation' alag figures hain. Barh ka role Bihar ki growing electricity demand ko central generating station se support dena hai. 2025 mein 660 MW Unit-3 ke COD ke baad project ki remaining capacity bhi commissioned status mein aa gayi. Isliye current exam preparation mein Barh ko Bihar ke sabse bade operational NTPC coal stations mein se ek ke roop mein 3300 MW ke saath revise karein.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash utilisation, emission control and efficient large-unit technology
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Coal jalane wale plant mein fly ash, smoke emissions aur water use main environmental challenges hote hain. Barh mein ash handling aur pollution-control systems ka use hota hai, taki coal burning se nikle waste ko controlled manner mein manage kiya ja sake. Fly ash ko cement, concrete, bricks aur construction material mein use karna disposal pressure ko kam kar sakta hai. Newer 660 MW units mein high-efficiency generation technology ka objective same fuel se better electricity output paana hai. Ganga water source hone ke karan water management bhi important hai. BPSC answer mein environmental angle likhte waqt 'coal combustion → fly ash → ash utilisation' ka simple chain bana sakte hain. Green-energy transition ke bawajood Barh jaise thermal stations Bihar ke present electricity system mein important conventional generation source bane hue hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Barh Super Thermal Power Station ki current commissioned capacity 3300 MW hai.
Barh NTPC ka operational coal-based Super Thermal Power Station hai.
2025 mein Stage-I Unit-3, 660 MW, ka COD declare hua, jisse 3300 MW project configuration complete hui.
Barh ko Patna district, Ganga river, NTPC aur 3300 MW thermal power station ke context mein revise karein.

plant_name: NTPC Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station (एनटीपीसी कहलगांव सुपर थर्मल पावर स्टेशन)

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Ganga water + Rajmahal Coal Fields + railway coal transport
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station Bhagalpur district ke Kahalgaon area mein Ganga ke kinare located hai. Thermal power station ko continuous cooling water aur bahut large quantity mein coal chahiye hota hai. Kahalgaon ko Ganga se water source aur Eastern Coalfields Limited ke Rajmahal Coal Fields se coal linkage milta hai. Railway network coal rakes ko plant tak lane mein important role play karta hai. Plant mein Stage-I ke 4 units 210 MW ke aur Stage-II ke 3 units 500 MW ke hain, jisse total capacity 2340 MW banti hai. Kahalgaon ka location eastern Bihar ke liye strategically important hai aur eastern regional power network se connected hai. BPSC ke liye ek simple memory formula rakhein—'Kahalgaon = Bhagalpur + Ganga + Rajmahal Coalfield + NTPC + 2340 MW'.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 2025-26 firm allocation data mein Bihar ko Kahalgaon-I aur II se 0 MW firm allocation listed hai; allocation orders year-wise change ho sakte hain
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Kahalgaon ki total installed capacity 2340 MW hai, lekin central generating station ki electricity multiple beneficiary states ko allocation ke according milti hai. NTPC ke official station profile mein Bihar beneficiary states mein listed hai. Recent Eastern Region firm-allocation table mein Kahalgaon-I aur Kahalgaon-II ke saamne Bihar ka firm allocation 0 MW listed tha, jo dikhata hai ki allocation arrangements ko plant capacity ke saath directly equate nahi karna chahiye. Isliye BPSC answer mein safest core fact hai: 'Kahalgaon = 2340 MW central-sector station, Bhagalpur, Ganga, Rajmahal Coal Fields'. Agar question kisi particular financial year ke allocation par ho, to us year ka allocation order follow karna chahiye. Plant Bihar ke eastern power network aur wider Eastern Region generation system ka important source hai.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash utilisation, ash handling and emission-control measures
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Kahalgaon jaise large coal plant mein sabse visible environmental challenge fly ash hota hai. Coal burn hone ke baad bachi ash ko ash pond mein rakhne ke bajay cement, concrete, bricks aur other construction products mein use karna better utilisation approach hai. Plant mein dry fly ash handling aur sale mechanisms ka bhi use hota raha hai. Ganga water source hone ke karan cooling-water management aur wastewater treatment important environmental tasks hain. Air emissions ko control karne ke liye plant-level pollution-control systems use kiye jaate hain. BPSC ke descriptive answer mein Kahalgaon ka environment section likhte hue 'fly ash management + water management + emission control' teen points enough hain. Is plant ka green-energy alternative solar ya hydro nahi hai, lekin cleaner operation aur waste utilisation thermal generation ke environmental impact ko manage karne ke important methods hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station ki installed capacity 2340 MW hai: 4x210 MW + 3x500 MW.
Kahalgaon NTPC ka operational coal-based power station hai.
Ganga water aur Rajmahal Coal Fields of ECL iska key geographical-fuel combination hai.
Bhagalpur mein sthit Kahalgaon Thermal Power Station ko Ganga aur Rajmahal Coal Fields se connect karke yaad karein.

plant_name: NTPC Nabinagar Super Thermal Power Station - NPGC (एनटीपीसी नवीनगर सुपर थर्मल पावर स्टेशन)

technical_metrics.water_source: Sone River system through Indrapuri Barrage
technical_metrics.coal_linkage_or_source: Coal India-linked coal supply through rail transport

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Sone water through Indrapuri Barrage + railway coal transport
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Nabinagar Super Thermal Power Station South Bihar ke Aurangabad district mein Majhiyan area mein sthit hai. Large thermal plant ke liye water aur coal dono ki dependable supply zaroori hoti hai. Nabinagar ko Sone River system se Indrapuri Barrage ke through water supply milti hai, jo cooling requirement ke liye important hai. Coal railway network se plant tak transport kiya jata hai. Operational Stage-I mein 3 units hain aur har unit 660 MW ka hai, isliye total commissioned capacity 1980 MW hai. Plant South Bihar ke power network ko support karta hai aur nearby railway connectivity fuel logistics ko easier banati hai. Map par isko yaad karne ka easiest formula hai—'Aurangabad + Nabinagar + Sone/Indrapuri + 3x660 MW'. Isse Nabinagar ko BRBCL ke separate 1000 MW project se confuse nahi karna chahiye.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 2025-26 firm allocation table mein Bihar ka Nabinagar STPP-I share 1552.50 MW listed hai
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Nabinagar STPP-I ki total installed capacity 1980 MW hai. Iski electricity central generating system ke through beneficiary states ko allocation ke according milti hai. Recent Eastern Region firm-allocation table mein Bihar ka Nabinagar STPP-I share 1552.50 MW listed hai. Isse clear hota hai ki Bihar ko plant ki total capacity ka ek large allocated portion milta hai, lekin plant ki generating capacity aur state allocation same concept nahi hain. Nabinagar South Bihar ki electricity requirement ko support karne mein important role play karta hai. BPSC ke numerical question mein 1980 MW ko plant capacity aur allocation table mein diye Bihar share ko separately identify karna chahiye. Exam memory ke liye 'NPGC = 1980 MW = 3x660 MW' aur 'Aurangabad = Sone basin' ko fixed pair ki tarah revise karein.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash utilisation, water management and high-efficiency large units
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Nabinagar coal-based plant mein coal burning ke karan fly ash aur air emissions major environmental concerns hain. Ash handling system ka purpose ash ko safely collect aur transport karna hai, jabki fly ash ko cement, bricks aur construction products mein use kiya ja sakta hai. Sone River system se water milne ke karan water conservation aur wastewater management bhi important hai. 660 MW units comparatively large generating units hain, jahan efficient operation ka objective fuel ka better use karna hota hai. Environmental answer mein Nabinagar ke liye 'coal → electricity → fly ash → useful construction material' ka cycle explain kiya ja sakta hai. Saath hi Sone water source ko mention karna geographical linkage strong banata hai. Future expansion ko current operational capacity mein add nahi karna chahiye; exam mein sirf commissioned NPGC Stage-I ke liye 1980 MW likhna safest current fact hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Nabinagar STPP-I ki operational installed capacity 1980 MW hai, configured as 3x660 MW.
Nabinagar-NPGC NTPC ke operational coal stations mein listed hai.
Sone River system aur Indrapuri Barrage se water supply iska important location-based fact hai.
Nabinagar Thermal Power Station ko Aurangabad, 1980 MW aur Sone/Indrapuri water source ke saath revise karein.

plant_name: Nabinagar Thermal Power Project - BRBCL (नवीनगर थर्मल पावर प्रोजेक्ट)
operator_agency: BRBCL - NTPC and Indian Railways Joint Venture

location.exact_site: Nabinagar, near Nabinagar Road Railway Station

technical_metrics.water_source: Upper Sone River through Indrapuri Barrage
technical_metrics.coal_linkage_or_source: Pachra & Pachra South Block, North Karanpura Coalfields, CCL

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Sone water + CCL coal + railway connectivity
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: BRBCL ka Nabinagar Thermal Power Project Aurangabad district mein Nabinagar area mein sthit hai. Ye NPGC ke 1980 MW Nabinagar STPP se alag project hai, isliye dono ko exam mein mix nahi karna chahiye. BRBCL NTPC aur Indian Railways ka joint venture hai. Project ki 1000 MW capacity 4x250 MW units mein hai. Water requirement ke liye upper Sone River ka water Indrapuri Barrage se allocated hai. Coal linkage Pachra aur Pachra South Block, North Karanpura Coalfields, CCL se diya gaya hai. Project site Nabinagar Road Railway Station ke relatively close hai, jo coal transport aur logistics ke liye useful hai. Is project ka special feature ye bhi hai ki generated power ke beneficiaries mein Indian Railways aur Bihar State dono hain. BPSC ke liye 'BRBCL = Railway + NTPC + Nabinagar + 1000 MW' yaad rakhein.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 1000 MW project mein Indian Railways ka 90% aur Bihar State ka 10% beneficiary share
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: BRBCL Nabinagar ki total commissioned capacity 1000 MW hai. BRBCL ke official profile ke according generated power ke beneficiaries Indian Railways ko 90% aur Bihar State ko 10% hain. Isliye Bihar ka direct beneficiary share 100 MW ke equivalent capacity ke aas-paas banta hai, subject to actual scheduling and generation. Ye project ordinary NTPC station se alag hai kyunki iska ownership structure NTPC aur Indian Railways ke joint venture par based hai. Indian Railways ko large share dene ka relation railway traction power requirement se hai. BPSC mein question aa sakta hai ki Nabinagar mein NTPC ke alawa railway-linked thermal project kaunsa hai—answer BRBCL Nabinagar Thermal Power Project. Important distinction: NPGC Nabinagar = 1980 MW; BRBCL Nabinagar = 1000 MW.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash management, emission control and efficient coal utilisation
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: BRBCL ka project coal-based hai, isliye fly ash, air emissions aur water consumption iske main environmental concerns hain. Plant mein ash collection aur handling arrangements ka purpose coal combustion se nikli ash ko controlled manner mein manage karna hai. Fly ash ka cement, bricks aur construction material mein use waste reduction ka practical method hai. Water requirement Sone River system se Indrapuri Barrage ke through meet hoti hai, isliye water-use efficiency aur wastewater management bhi important hai. Project ki 4x250 MW configuration large-scale generation provide karti hai aur railway power requirement ko support karti hai. Environmental answer mein ye point useful hai ki electricity generation ka social benefit aur coal-based pollution-control requirement dono saath-saath manage karne padte hain. Exam ke liye BRBCL ko NPGC se separate entity ke roop mein revise karna sabse important hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: BRBCL Nabinagar Thermal Power Project ki commissioned capacity 1000 MW, yani 4x250 MW hai.
BRBCL NTPC subsidiary hai aur Indian Railways ke saath 74:26 equity joint venture hai.
Power beneficiary structure mein Indian Railways 90% aur Bihar State 10% share rakhta hai.
Nabinagar mein Indian Railways-linked thermal project ka naam aur capacity: BRBCL Nabinagar, 1000 MW.

plant_name: Kanti Bijlee Utpadan Nigam Limited - KBUNL (कांटी थर्मल पावर स्टेशन)

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Burhi Gandak water + railway coal transport
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Kanti Thermal Power Station Muzaffarpur district ke Kanti area mein located hai. Plant ke cooling-water requirement ke liye Burhi Gandak River system important water source hai. Coal railway ke through plant tak laya jata hai. Historical configuration mein Stage-I ke 2x110 MW aur Stage-II ke 2x195 MW units the, jisse total 610 MW capacity bani thi. Lekin old Stage-I units ko permanently shut down kar diya gaya, aur current NTPC station profile Kanti ki commissioned capacity 390 MW list karta hai. Isliye current BPSC notes mein 390 MW ko operational capacity ke roop mein use karna chahiye. Kanti North Bihar ke industrial city Muzaffarpur ko power supply network se support karta hai. Map-based revision mein 'Muzaffarpur + Kanti + Burhi Gandak + NTPC + 390 MW' ko ek unit ki tarah yaad karein.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 390 MW installed capacity; 2025-26 firm allocation table mein Bihar ka KBUNL-II share 264.03 MW listed hai
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Kanti ki current commissioned capacity 390 MW hai. Recent Eastern Region allocation data mein KBUNL-II ke liye Bihar ka firm allocation 264.03 MW listed hai. Ye figure plant ki total installed capacity nahi hai; ye Bihar beneficiary allocation ko represent karta hai. Kanti ka geographical advantage ye hai ki ye North Bihar ke major urban-industrial centre Muzaffarpur mein situated hai. Electricity generation ke saath plant Bihar ke regional grid ko conventional thermal support deta hai. Exam mein historical 610 MW aur current 390 MW ke difference ko samajhna important hai. Agar question current installed capacity pooche to 390 MW likhein. Agar historical Stage-I + Stage-II configuration poocha jaye to 610 MW context explain kiya ja sakta hai. Is tarah old GK books ke figures se confusion avoid hoga.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash handling, treated-water reuse and emission-control systems
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Kanti thermal station mein coal burning se fly ash aur air emissions generate hote hain. Isliye ash handling, ash disposal aur pollution-control systems plant ke environmental management ka important part hain. Fly ash ko cement, bricks aur other construction products mein use karna useful disposal method hai. Water management bhi important hai kyunki cooling system ke liye Burhi Gandak River source use hota hai. Treated wastewater ko plant ke selected internal uses mein reuse karna freshwater demand ko reduce kar sakta hai. Purane 110 MW units ke shutdown ke baad current generation 2x195 MW Stage-II units se associated hai. BPSC answer mein environmental challenge ke roop mein 'coal ash + water use + emissions' aur solution ke roop mein 'ash utilisation + wastewater reuse + pollution control' likhna sufficient hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kanti ki current commissioned capacity 390 MW hai; historical full configuration 610 MW thi.
Kanti Bijlee Utpadan Nigam Limited ka NTPC ke saath ownership relationship raha hai aur current NTPC station profile mein Kanti 390 MW listed hai.
Burhi Gandak River water source aur current 2x195 MW operation iske key technical facts hain.
Muzaffarpur ka Kanti Thermal Power Station, KBUNL aur current 390 MW capacity ko direct factual question ke liye revise karein.

plant_name: Barauni Thermal Power Station (बरौनी थर्मल पावर स्टेशन)

technical_metrics.installed_capacity_mw: 500 MW commissioned capacity in current NTPC station listing
technical_metrics.coal_linkage_or_source: Coal linkage through Coal India system

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Ganga water + railway/road connectivity + coal supply
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Barauni Thermal Power Station Begusarai ke Barauni industrial area mein located hai. Barauni Bihar ke important industrial aur railway hubs mein se ek hai, isliye large power station ke liye fuel movement aur electricity transmission dono ke liye connectivity useful rahi. Ganga River water source cooling requirement ko support karta hai. NTPC ne Bihar State Power Generation Company se Barauni plant ko 2018 mein acquire kiya tha. Current NTPC station listing mein Barauni ki commissioned capacity 500 MW hai. Purane documents mein project ki larger planned capacity aur historical units ke figures mil sakte hain, isliye current commissioned figure ko question ke wording ke according use karna chahiye. BPSC ke map par ise 'Begusarai + Barauni industrial area + Ganga + NTPC' ke combination mein mark karein. Barauni refinery aur industrial ecosystem ke paas hone se regional economic importance bhi samajh aati hai.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 500 MW current commissioned NTPC capacity; Bihar beneficiary arrangements project-specific allocation/PPA ke through
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Barauni ki current NTPC commissioned capacity 500 MW listed hai. Is station ko central generating stations se alag historical background ke saath padhna chahiye, kyunki NTPC ne ise Bihar State Power Generation Company se acquire kiya tha. Project ki power Bihar ke electricity system ke liye important hai, especially because Barauni Bihar ke industrial corridor mein situated hai. Plant capacity aur Bihar ko actual scheduled power ek hi number nahi hote; generation, availability, PPA aur scheduling ke according actual supply change ho sakti hai. BPSC ke liye safest current fact hai 'Barauni TPS = Begusarai + NTPC + 500 MW commissioned capacity'. Historical project expansion figures ko current commissioned capacity ke saath mix nahi karna chahiye. Is distinction se old study material mein milne wale 720 MW type figures se confusion avoid hoga.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Fly-ash utilisation, ash handling and emission-control systems
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Barauni coal-based station ke environmental challenges mein fly ash, air emissions aur water use major points hain. Coal burn hone ke baad ash ko safely collect aur store karna zaroori hota hai. Better approach fly ash ko cement, bricks, concrete aur construction material mein utilise karna hai. Ganga water source hone ke karan cooling-water management aur wastewater treatment bhi important hai. NTPC ke modern operational practices ka focus emissions ko control karne, ash handling improve karne aur available water ko efficiently use karne par hota hai. BPSC descriptive answer mein Barauni ko Bihar ke industrial development se connect kiya ja sakta hai—reliable electricity industry ko support karti hai, lekin coal-based generation ke saath ash aur emissions management bhi zaroori hai. Isliye 'industrial power + environmental management' ko Barauni ka balanced theme samjhein.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Current NTPC station listing mein Barauni ki commissioned capacity 500 MW hai.
NTPC ne Barauni Thermal Power Station ko Bihar State Power Generation Company se 2018 mein acquire kiya.
Barauni ka key identity Begusarai ke industrial region, Ganga water source aur NTPC operation se banta hai.
Barauni Thermal Power Station = Begusarai; current NTPC commissioned capacity 500 MW.

plant_name: Darbhanga Kadirabad Floating Solar Power Plant (दरभंगा कादिराबाद फ्लोटिंग सोलर पावर प्लांट)

site_selection_and_infrastructure.cooling_and_fuel_logistics: Floating photovoltaic panels on pond + electrical grid connection
site_selection_and_infrastructure.explanation: Kadirabad, Darbhanga mein Bihar ka first floating solar power plant establish kiya gaya. Is project ka basic idea bahut simple hai—zameen par solar panels ka bada field banane ke bajay paani ki surface par floating platforms ke upar solar modules lagaye jaate hain. Isse land requirement comparatively kam hoti hai aur existing water body ka productive use hota hai. Project ki capacity 2 MW hai aur preparation BREDA ke supervision mein hui thi. 68th BPSC Preliminary examination mein Bihar ke first floating solar power plant ka location directly poocha gaya tha, jiska answer Kadirabad, Darbhanga tha. Isliye ye Bihar GK ke liye high-value factual item hai. Map par Darbhanga ko mark karke 'Kadirabad = first floating solar = 2 MW' likh dena quick revision ke liye best mnemonic hai.

generation_capacity_and_grid_share.bihar_allocation_share: 2 MW; Bihar ke renewable-energy system ke liye state-level project
generation_capacity_and_grid_share.explanation: Kadirabad floating solar plant ki installed capacity 2 MW hai. Thermal station ki tarah yahan coal, boiler aur steam turbine ka use nahi hota. Solar panels sunlight ko electricity mein convert karte hain aur electrical system ke through generated power grid ko supply ki ja sakti hai. 2 MW capacity Barh ya Kahalgaon jaise thermal plants ki comparison mein bahut chhoti hai, lekin iska exam importance technology aur Bihar-first status ke karan high hai. Is project ko Bihar ke renewable-energy transition ka demonstration example samjha ja sakta hai. 68th BPSC Prelims mein is plant ka location poocha ja chuka hai. Isliye numerical fact ke saath location ko bhi pakka karein: 'Kadirabad, Darbhanga — 2 MW floating solar plant'.

environmental_challenges_and_innovations.fly_ash_or_green_impact: Clean solar generation, lower land requirement and floating-panel technology
environmental_challenges_and_innovations.explanation: Floating solar ka main green benefit ye hai ki solar electricity ke liye large land parcel ki requirement reduce ki ja sakti hai. Water body ki surface par panels lagne se agricultural ya urban land ko bachaya ja sakta hai. Coal burning nahi hoti, isliye fly ash generation bhi nahi hoti. Lekin floating structure ko strong wind, water-level changes, anchoring aur regular maintenance ke liye design karna padta hai. Water body ke aquatic ecosystem aur fishing activities par bhi dhyan dena important hai. Kadirabad project Bihar mein renewable-energy technology ke practical demonstration ke roop mein important hai. BPSC answer mein ek line yaad rakhein: 'Floating solar = paani par solar panel, land requirement kam, coal/fly ash nahi.' Location aur capacity ke saath iska first-in-Bihar status zaroor mention karein.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kadirabad Floating Solar Power Plant ki capacity 2 MW hai.
Project BREDA ke renewable-energy initiative ke roop mein developed/prepared hua.
Kadirabad, Darbhanga mein Bihar ka first floating solar power plant establish hua.
68th BPSC Prelims: Bihar ka first floating solar power plant kahan bana? Answer: Kadirabad, Darbhanga.
